mutations.transformation: Mutate schema, protocol version, experiment ID, commit, or manifest hash.
Inject a duplicate key, float, NaN, extra key, non-ASCII byte, or truncation.
Mutate p, a, b, q, trace, j, or an accepted attempt.
Reorder, delete, duplicate, or break sign-completeness of a factor point.
Mutate FB_DIGEST, FBE width, domain, control index, or endpoint order.
Delete, duplicate, add identity to, or change the output of one fiber witness.
Mutate a secant denominator, tangent formula, canonical slope, intercept, or tie count.
Mutate one candidate, formal-lex, or hash-control representative.
Break reverse-order or hash-ranked source-label equivariance.
Mutate a chart exponent, transformed coefficient, point sorting, or fixture digest.
Include chart scalar u in the chart payload and falsely separate u=-1 from u=1.
Flatten without multiset sorting or mutate a duplicate collapse.
Mutate eligibility, a conflict edge, or reduced density.
Use field modulus p instead of group order q for a cap.
Mutate objective order, witness tie-break, or branch order.
Mutate a bound, gap, frontier, termination reason, or full-exactness flag.
Reuse a worker PID, cache, incumbent, checkpoint, or frontier.
Undercharge an operation, failed attempt, RSS, time, I/O, or storage field.
Promote a metric tie to a finite-rank win.
Mutate a cross-chart, cap, or seed quantifier, or terminal precedence.
Mutate a control fixture, expected oracle, or exhaustive-row digest.
Make the verifier import the producer, worker, inherited producer, or inherited verifier.
Alter producer output after the verifier snapshot read.
Precreate, symlink, replace, or force a partial publication target.

mutation_manifest.required_outcome: All 24 independently refreshed mutations are rejected by their declared detectors.
